_help: The console's Library tab. Each item is fetched from Higgsfield when the site builds and served from /console/library/ (behind the console password). kind: video | image. made: room = filmed in the salon and only graded, so it can be used as ours; ai = generated, for close-ups, reels and explainers only, never shown as a real client or a result. To add one: copy its id and the cloudfront url from Higgsfield, give it a title and a use, rebuild.

items.title: Hero film, desktop (first cut)
items.use: 16 seconds, loops. Waiting area, the couch and mirror, the SPF trolley, back to the start. Silent, for the top of the website.

items.title: Hero film, phone (first cut)
items.use: 20 seconds, loops. The treatment chair, then the other rooms. The same idea, cut for a phone screen and for reels.

items.title: The treatment chair by the frosted window
items.use: A slow pull back. Opens a reel about skin or aesthetics, or sits behind a caption.

items.title: The couch and the wavy mirror
items.use: A slow push in past the treatment couch. The calm before a facial, or a first-visit explainer.

items.title: The waiting area
items.use: Down the lounge to the bouclé chairs. For 'what to expect when you arrive'.

items.title: The gold trolley and the SPF shelf
items.use: A slow push in on the sunscreen. Aftercare, SPF reminders, anything about looking after skin at home.

items.title: The consultation desk, brought to life
items.use: Made from the AI desk picture below. Behind text about consultations and booking in.

items.title: The consultation desk
items.use: An empty desk, open diary, the treatment pen at rest. Consultations, booking, first visits.

items.title: Fan brush on the cheek
items.use: A skin close-up, real texture. Peels and facials explainers.

items.title: On the couch, cream along the cheekbone
items.use: A client mid-facial, eyes closed. The feeling of a treatment, not a result.

items.title: Gloved hands at the tray
items.use: Clean, prepared, careful. Hygiene, prep, 'what happens first'.

items.title: Gloved hands at the tray, lamp light
items.use: A second take on the tray, warmer. Same uses.

items.title: Gloved hands at the tray, macro
items.use: A third take, closer on the glass. Same uses.
